name: DialogPay Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: dialogpay

sections.description:
Accept credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and local wallets securely with DialogPay — your all-in-one payment gateway for WooCommerce.

Note: This plugin connects securely to the DialogPay API to process transactions.

External services

This plugin connects to the DialogPay Payment Gateway API (https://checkout-ms.dialog-pay.com) to authorize and process payments securely within WooCommerce.

When a customer checks out, the following data is securely transmitted to the DialogPay API:
– Order details (order ID, total amount, and currency)
– Customer billing details (name, email, and address)
– Payment method information (e.g., card type, wallet type — never full card numbers)

This connection is required for processing and confirming payments between your WooCommerce store and DialogPay.

DialogPay is a PCI-DSS compliant payment processor.
You can review DialogPay’s policies here:
– Terms of Service: https://www.dialogpay.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://www.dialogpay.com/privacy-policy

All communication occurs over encrypted HTTPS connections.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dialogpay-payment-gateway-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins → Installed Plugins page.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → DialogPay to configure your credentials.
sections.faq:
Is DialogPay a white-label payment gateway?

Yes. DialogPay provides a seamless checkout experience under your own brand.

Does DialogPay support Apple Pay and Google Pay?

Yes, if these methods are enabled on your DialogPay merchant account.
sections.changelog:
1.0.7

  • Enhanced debug mode: captures and displays raw API responses on failure
  • Improved error extraction logic for non-JSON or malformed responses
  • Force-enabled internal logging for troubleshooting

1.0.6

  • Fixed URL encoding bug in API payload that caused missing checkout links
  • Improved error reporting to display API error messages directly on checkout

1.0.5

  • Fixed TypeError in WooCommerce Store API (Blocks checkout) during payment processing failure
  • Improved error handling return values for better compatibility with modern checkout

1.0.4

  • Fixed fatal error in WooCommerce Blocks integration by adding class existence checks
  • Improved stability for older WooCommerce versions

1.0.3

  • Added support for WooCommerce Checkout Blocks & Cart Blocks
  • Implemented Block Integration layer for Gutenberg compatibility
  • Fixed React rendering issues in payment section for modern checkout layouts
  • Optimized logo and asset loading for block-based checkout

1.0.2

  • Fixed payment configuration display issues
  • General stability improvements

1.0.1

  • Stable release
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatible
  • Added support links (Email & WhatsApp)
  • Documented use of DialogPay external API service
  1. Secure and seamless payment experience with DialogPay integration for easy online transactions.
  2. Effortless checkout process with DialogPay, offering secure payments and real-time confirmation.
  3. Thank you for your purchase! Your order has been successfully placed using DialogPay.
  4. Easily configure DialogPay for your WooCommerce store to enable fast and secure payment processing.
